summary: After the individual meetings, the employer meets with everyone left to acknowledge the loss.
realLife: HR guidance advises a meeting with all remaining staff after notifications, since survivors may grieve and feel uncertain, and acknowledging their feelings.
sources: SHRM, Layoffs require communication, compassion, compliance: https://www.shrm.org/mena/topics-tools/news/talent-acquisition/layoffs-require-communication-compassion-compliance
inGame: New-coworker and job-ended events at one workplace; remaining coworkers' mood can read from the count of ended jobs.
